counter_design.representation: Keep original ready/compute/comparison homes; append one private remaining-traversal word after the existing region homes, preserving all packed-map home offsets. The original pair remains unchanged during native body execution.
counter_design.entry: N=min(C/c,P/p), with zero comparison price contributing no limit; compute price is nonzero by existing closed-tail derivation.
counter_design.header: One check and decrement at the original charged header, including the terminal traversal.
counter_design.settlement: Recompute initial N from the unchanged original pair; t=N-remaining. Reconstruct C-t*c and P-t*p before the existing end callback on exit, pause, failure and fallback.
counter_design.wire: Preserve the existing end-callback arguments and runtime reconciliation; admit the additional real private word and clear it at checkpoints.
counter_design.qualification: Differential compiled-source tests across original/decoded artifacts, repeated prefixes, Unicode/CRLF, source errors and exact/one-short independent finite budget dimensions.

promotion: No diagnostic-only reduction, static instruction change, or interval including zero establishes a runtime improvement.
